translated: Alright, let's take a look at the illustrations for the members appearing this time.
Also, for the AfterLive, I'm planning to create a private room so I can enjoy it together with all of you.
I'll be sharing the Room ID around 8:55 PM,
so if you start doing some finger exercises around then and type in the numbers really fast, we might be able to watch the live together.
Please come and join me!
Someone wrote, "There are 200 shades of white."
That's right, there are 200 shades of white.
Indeed.
Anyway, I'd like to start looking back on the story of our event, "Our Survival Struggle."
It was sort of the Mizuki-perspective version of the story from the previous Kanade event. It wasn't so much about the plot moving forward,
but more about how Mizuki felt seeing what was happening with Kanade and Mafuyu.
Just having someone nearby who tells you it's okay to run away...
it really puts your mind at ease. It made me realize how important it is to put those feelings into words.
That's how I felt, anyway.
The recording was really heavy, too.
I mean, when it comes to recording... unlike anime where you can record with others,
for games, you record all by yourself.
Since I rarely get to hear what the others have recorded, I didn't have a clear image of how Rui-chan would perform her lines.
I had to use my imagination, so when I actually saw the event, I thought, "Wow, everyone is such a good actor!" Like Ena, for example.
If it were me, I'd probably just blurt things out, but Ena has this way of being persuasive yet firm.
Minori-chan is just amazing.
She was seriously incredible.
This event really made me realize how much I love N25.
If there are any scenes that left an impression on you, please let me know.
Which episode stood out to you all?
Actually, we can watch one episode together right here, so please spam the chat with which one you want to see. I see people saying Episode 8 was good, but...
3, 7... Ah, it looks like 7 is the popular choice.
The 7s are just flooding in now. 7, 7, 7... Okay, Episode 7 it is.
Understood.
